# Button Component

### Button

**Exports:**
- `Button` - Button component
- `ButtonProps`, `ButtonSize`, `ButtonVariant`, `ButtonShape` - types

**Props (Geist-aligned):**
- `size`: 'tiny' | 'small' | 'medium' | 'large' (default: 'medium')
- `variant`: 'default' | 'secondary' | 'tertiary' | 'error' | 'warning' (default: 'default')
- `shape`: 'square' | 'circle' | 'rounded' | undefined
- `svgOnly`: boolean - Icon-only layout; requires aria-label or aria-labelledby
- `prefix`: Snippet - Icon content before the label
- `suffix`: Snippet - Icon content after the label
- `shadow`: boolean - Soft elevation (often with shape="rounded")
- `loading`: boolean - Keeps focus, sets aria-busy/aria-disabled, shows spinner
- `disabled`: boolean
- `buttonElement`: HTMLButtonElement - Bindable reference
- `class`: ClassValue
- `children`: Snippet
- Extends `HTMLButtonAttributes` (default `type="button"`)

**Usage:**
```svelte
<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from 'kampsy-ui';
	import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp } from 'kampsy-ui/icons';
</script>

<Button size="small">Upload</Button>
<Button variant="secondary">Upload</Button>

<Button aria-label="Upload" shape="square" svgOnly>
	<ArrowUp />
</Button>

<Button>
	{#snippet prefix()}
		<ArrowLeft />
	{/snippet}
	{#snippet suffix()}
		<ArrowRight />
	{/snippet}
	Upload
</Button>

<Button variant="secondary" shape="rounded" shadow>Upload</Button>
<Button loading>Upload</Button>
```

## Installation

```bash
pnpm i -D kampsy-ui@latest
```

## Documentation

Visit http://ui.kampsy.xyz/button for full documentation and examples.
